plan: SCAN(paintings_metadata) -> FILTER({religious_artwork}: genre/movement match, no filter for 'painting') -> SORT(inception {oldest}) -> LIMIT(1) -> PROJECT(title)

JOIN(left=meta, right=imgs, on meta.img_path = imgs.img_path) -> SEM_MAP(painting_images: "What is depicted on this painting?") -> PROJECT(title, depiction)

plan: SCAN(players) -> FILTER(position = {small_forward}) -> SORT({tallest}: height or birth_date) -> LIMIT(1) -> PROJECT(name)
basis: 纯关系查询：players 表按 position 过滤，{tallest} 映射到 height（tallest/smallest）或 birth_date（oldest/youngest）排序取第一，输出 name；无语义步骤。position 为多值字符串，实际可能需 LIKE 匹配。

plan: SCAN(teams) -> FILTER(conference/division = {eastern_conference}) -> SORT(founded {oldest}) -> LIMIT(1) -> PROJECT(name)
basis: 纯关系查询：teams 表按 conference 或 division 过滤（取决于取值是 conference 还是 Division），按 founded 排序取第一；无语义步骤。

plan: SCAN(players) -> AGGREGATE(group by {position}; row with {tallest} height/birth_date) -> PROJECT({position}, name)
basis: 纯关系查询：players 按 position 或 nationality 分组，取 height 或 birth_date 极值的球员；无语义步骤。

plan: SCAN(teams) -> AGGREGATE(group by {division}; row with {oldest} founded) -> PROJECT({division}, name)
basis: 纯关系查询：teams 按 division/conference 分组取 founded 最早/最晚的球队；无语义步骤。

plan: SCAN(players) -> AGGREGATE(group by {position}; row with {oldest} birth_date) -> COMPUTE({age_player}: age from birth_date, or height) -> COMPUTE(plot {age_player} per {position})
basis: 纯关系查询：players 按 position/nationality 分组取 birth_date 极值的球员，age 由 birth_date 计算（height 直接取列），最后绘图；无语义步骤。

plan: SCAN(teams) -> AGGREGATE(group by {division}; row with {oldest} founded) -> COMPUTE({age_team}: age from founded) -> COMPUTE(plot {age_team} per {division})
basis: 纯关系查询：teams 按 division/conference 分组取 founded 极值的球队，由 founded 计算 age 后绘图；无语义步骤。

JOIN(left=p2g, right=reports, on p2g.game_id = reports.game_id) -> SEM_MAP(game_reports: "How many {points} did <player name> make?" -> num_{points}) -> SORT(num_{points} {highest}) -> LIMIT(1) -> PROJECT(name)
